_comment: OTA-234 — ingested from Player_skills_and_abilities_table.docx. The 19 canonical TTRPG skills mapped to 5 ability scores. SHIPPED APP USES ITS OWN STAT SYSTEM (5 abilities, no skill subsystem) so these are LORE ONLY — the Arbiter knows about them, can describe what they affect, but the app's effectiveStats / dice math do not consume them. Per the user's directive: app > lore on shipped mechanics. Phase 2 may attach skill flavor to existing checks (e.g., a stealth check narrates as 'Stealth check'), but no balance change.

skills.name: Prowess
skills.affects: Physical tasks like swimming, lifting, hitting.

skills.name: Grip
skills.affects: Physical tasks like grappling, climbing, holding onto something.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.affects: Balance, agility, and performing flips or dodges.

skills.name: Chicanery
skills.affects: Manual dexterity for tasks like picking pockets or lockpicking.

skills.name: Etheria
skills.affects: Understanding etheric theory and knowledge of ethereal power and usage.

skills.name: Schooling
skills.affects: Knowledge of historical events, cultures, science and legends.

skills.name: Woodsman
skills.affects: Knowledge of the natural world and its creatures.

skills.name: Whisperer
skills.affects: Handling animals and calming them down.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.affects: Treating wounds and stabilizing the injured.

skills.name: Observation
skills.affects: Noticing hidden things, danger, or creatures.

skills.name: Instincts
skills.affects: Surviving in the wilderness, tracking, and foraging.

skills.name: Coercion
skills.affects: Coercing others through threats or force.

skills.name: Performance
skills.affects: Entertaining others with music, acting, or storytelling.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.affects: Convincing others through charm or debate.
